Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 assays against human single-protein target CHEMBL1163128 (Microtubule-associated serine/threonine-protein kinase 1) that have exact standard relation '=' and non-null pChEMBL values. Join molecule_dictionary, activities, assays, target_dictionary, and compound_structures. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Order the results by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
